<h1 id="hub-api-endpoints">Hub API Endpoints v0.0.1</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

We have open endpoints that you can use to retrieve information from the Hub as well as perform certain actions such as creating model, dataset or Space repos. We offer a wrapper Python client, [`huggingface_hub`](https://github.com/huggingface/huggingface_hub), and a JS client, [`huggingface.js`](https://github.com/huggingface/huggingface.js), that allow easy access to these endpoints. We also provide [webhooks](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/webhooks) to receive real-time incremental info about repos. Enjoy!

The base URL for those endpoints below is `https://huggingface.co`. For example, to construct the `/api/models` call below, one can call the URL [https://huggingface.co/api/models](https://huggingface.co/api/models).

If you're an Agent, you might prefer the [markdown version OpenAPI spec](https://huggingface.co/.well-known/openapi.md).

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://huggingface.co">https://huggingface.co</a> - Hub

# Authentication

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer

<h1 id="hub-api-endpoints-auth">auth</h1>

The following endpoints get information about your currently used user based on the passed token.

## Get folder size

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/string/string/treesize/string/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/models/{namespace}/{repo}/treesize/{rev}/{path}`

Get the total size of a repository at a given revision, optionally under a specific subpath. Returns the total size in bytes of all files under the specified path (recursively). If a file is stored via Xet/LFS, the LFS file size is used.

<h3 id="get-folder-size-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|rev|path|string|true|none|
|path|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "path": "string",
  "size": -9007199254740000
}
```

<h3 id="get-folder-size-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Total size of a repository at a given revision, under the given path|Inline|

<h3 id="get-folder-size-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|path|string|true|none|The normalized path of the subtree, starting with a slash|
|size|integer|true|none|Total size in bytes of all files under the subtree|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Get safetensors metadata

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/string/string/safetensors-metadata/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/models/{namespace}/{repo}/safetensors-metadata/{path}`

Get the parsed headers of all the shards of a sharded safetensors model in a single request, instead of reading the index and then the header of every shard.

Only the `main` revision is served: the `ETag` is the commit sha of `main`, and requests with a matching `If-None-Match` get a 304. Returns 400 when the path isn't a `.safetensors.index.json` file and 422 when the files can't be parsed.

The response is brotli-compressed when the client accepts it, otherwise gzip-compressed or plain JSON.

<h3 id="get-safetensors-metadata-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|path|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "sharded": true,
  "index": {
    "metadata": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    }
  },
  "headers": {
    "property1": {
      "property1": {
        "dtype": "string",
        "shape": [
          -9007199254740000
        ],
        "data_offsets": [
          -9007199254740000,
          -9007199254740000
        ]
      },
      "property2": {
        "dtype": "string",
        "shape": [
          -9007199254740000
        ],
        "data_offsets": [
          -9007199254740000,
          -9007199254740000
        ]
      }
    },
    "property2": {
      "property1": {
        "dtype": "string",
        "shape": [
          -9007199254740000
        ],
        "data_offsets": [
          -9007199254740000,
          -9007199254740000
        ]
      },
      "property2": {
        "dtype": "string",
        "shape": [
          -9007199254740000
        ],
        "data_offsets": [
          -9007199254740000,
          -9007199254740000
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "parameterCount": {
    "property1": -9007199254740000,
    "property2": -9007199254740000
  },
  "parameterTotal": -9007199254740000,
  "filepaths": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-safetensors-metadata-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Parsed headers of the shards of a sharded safetensors model|Inline|

<h3 id="get-safetensors-metadata-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sharded|boolean|true|none|none|
|index|object|true|none|The index file, without its `weight_map`: each shard header lists its tensors|
|» metadata|object|false|none|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|string \| number|false|none|none|
|headers|object|true|none|The header of each shard, by shard file name: `__metadata__`, then the `dtype`, `shape` and `data_offsets` of each tensor|
|» **additionalProperties**|object|false|none|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|object|false|none|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|object|false|none|none|
|» » » dtype|string|true|none|none|
|» » » shape|[integer]|true|none|none|
|» » » data_offsets|[integer, integer]|true|none|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|object|false|none|none|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|string|false|none|none|
|parameterCount|object|true|none|Number of parameters per dtype|
|» **additionalProperties**|integer|false|none|none|
|parameterTotal|integer|false|none|none|
|filepaths|[string]|true|none|The index file, then every shard file|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Duplicate xet files

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/string/string/lfs-files/duplicate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "target": {
      "type": "model",
      "name": "string"
    },
    "files": [
      {
        "xetHash": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
        "sha256": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
        "filename": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/models/{namespace}/{repo}/lfs-files/duplicate`

Duplicate xet-stored files from this repo (source) into another repo (target) by xet hash, without re-uploading file bytes. The caller must then commit the files with their sha256/size as usual.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "target": {
    "type": "model",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "files": [
    {
      "xetHash": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
      "sha256": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
      "filename": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="duplicate-xet-files-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» target|body|object|true|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » name|body|string|true|none|
|» files|body|[object]|true|none|
|» » xetHash|body|string|true|none|
|» » sha256|body|string|true|none|
|» » filename|body|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » type|model|
|» » type|space|
|» » type|dataset|
|» » type|kernel|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processed": -9007199254740000,
  "succeeded": -9007199254740000,
  "failed": [
    {
      "xetHash": "string",
      "sha256": "string",
      "error": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 207 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processed": -9007199254740000,
  "succeeded": -9007199254740000,
  "failed": [
    {
      "xetHash": "string",
      "sha256": "string",
      "error": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="duplicate-xet-files-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Duplicate xet files response|Inline|
|207|Multi-Status|Duplicate xet files response|Inline|

<h3 id="duplicate-xet-files-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|success|boolean|true|none|True if all requested files were duplicated (or already present)|
|processed|integer|true|none|Total number of unique files processed|
|succeeded|integer|true|none|Number of files duplicated or already present in the target|
|failed|[object]|true|none|Per-file failures|
|» xetHash|string|true|none|Xet content hash of the file that failed|
|» sha256|string|true|none|sha256 of the file that failed|
|» error|string|true|none|Error message|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|» » sample|body|string|true|none|

## Commit

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/string/string/commit/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/models/{namespace}/{repo}/commit/{rev}`

For legacy reason, we support both `application/json` and `application/x-ndjson` but we recommend using `application/x-ndjson` to create a commit.

JSON-lines payload:
```json
{
  "key": "header",
  "value": {
    "summary": "string (REQUIRED)",
    "description": "string (OPTIONAL - defaults to empty string)",
    "parentCommit": "string (OPTIONAL - 40-character hex SHA)"
  }
}
{
  "key": "file",
  "value": {
    "path": "string (REQUIRED)",
    "content": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set)",
    "encoding": "utf-8 | base64 (OPTIONAL - defaults to utf-8)",
    "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
  }
}
{
  "key": "deletedEntry",
  "value": {
    "path": "string (REQUIRED)"
  }
}
{
  "key": "lfsFile",
  "value": {
    "path": "string (REQUIRED - max 1000 chars)",
    "oid": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set, 64 hex chars)",
    "algo": "sha256 (OPTIONAL - only sha256 supported)",
    "size": "number (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath is set)",
    "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
  }
}
```

JSON payload:
```json
{
  "summary": "string (REQUIRED)",
  "description": "string (OPTIONAL - defaults to empty string)",
  "parentCommit": "string (OPTIONAL - 40-character hex SHA)"
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "string (REQUIRED)",
      "content": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set)",
      "encoding": "utf-8 | base64 (OPTIONAL - defaults to utf-8)",
      "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
    }
  ],
  "deletedEntries": [
    {
      "path": "string (REQUIRED)"
    }
  ],
  "lfsFiles": [
    {
      "path": "string (REQUIRED - max 1000 chars)",
      "oid": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set, 64 hex chars)",
      "algo": "sha256 (OPTIONAL - only sha256 supported)",
      "size": "number (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath is set)",
      "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
    }
  ]
}
```


<h3 id="commit-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|rev|path|string|true|none|
|create_pr|query|string|false|none|
|hot_reload|query|string|false|none|
|Content-Type|header|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Content-Type|application/json|
|Content-Type|application/x-ndjson|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "pullRequestUrl": "string",
  "commitOid": "string",
  "commitUrl": "string",
  "hookOutput": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="commit-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The response of the commit|Inline|

<h3 id="commit-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|success|boolean|true|none|Whether the commit was successful|
|pullRequestUrl|string|false|none|The URL of the pull request|
|commitOid|string|true|none|The OID of the commit|
|commitUrl|string|true|none|The URL of the commit|
|hookOutput|string|true|none|The output of the git hook|

</aside>

## Generate JWT

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/string/string/jwt \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/models/{namespace}/{repo}/jwt`

Generate a JWT token for accessing a repository. Supports optional write access for spaces in dev mode, custom expiration, and encryption.

<h3 id="generate-jwt-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|write|query|string|false|none|
|expiration|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|expires_in|query|integer|false|none|
|encrypted|query|string|false|none|
|inference_api|query|string|false|none|
|include_pro_status|query|string|false|none|
|billing_details|query|string|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "accessToken": "string",
  "exp": -9007199254740000,
  "token": "string",
  "encryptedToken": {
    "encrypted": "string",
    "keyId": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="generate-jwt-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The JWT token and related information|Inline|

<h3 id="generate-jwt-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accessToken|string|true|none|The JWT token with Bearer prefix|
|exp|integer|false|none|Token expiration timestamp in seconds (JWT standard)|
|token|string|true|none|The JWT token|
|encryptedToken|object|false|none|Encrypted JWT token and key ID (only if encrypted=true was requested)|
|» encrypted|string|true|none|The encrypted JWT token|
|» keyId|string|true|none|Key ID used to encrypt the token|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

`POST /api/models/{namespace}/{repo}/user-access-request/batch`

Accept, reject, reset or set back to pending up to 100 access requests for a single gated repository in one call. The same `status` (and optional `rejectionReason` or `resetReason`) is applied to every request in the list.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "status": "accepted",
  "rejectionReason": "string",
  "resetReason": "string",
  "requests": [

      "requestId": "stringstringstringstring"
    }
  ]
}
```

`POST /api/kernels/{namespace}/{repo}/lfs-files/duplicate`

Duplicate xet-stored files from this repo (source) into another repo (target) by xet hash, without re-uploading file bytes. The caller must then commit the files with their sha256/size as usual.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "target": {
    "type": "model",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "files": [
    {
      "xetHash": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
      "sha256": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
      "filename": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

|body|body|object|false|none|

|» » name|body|string|true|none|
|» files|body|[object]|true|none|

## Get folder size

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/string/string/treesize/string/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/datasets/{namespace}/{repo}/treesize/{rev}/{path}`

Get the total size of a repository at a given revision, optionally under a specific subpath. Returns the total size in bytes of all files under the specified path (recursively). If a file is stored via Xet/LFS, the LFS file size is used.

<h3 id="get-folder-size-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|rev|path|string|true|none|
|path|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "path": "string",
  "size": -9007199254740000
}
```

<h3 id="get-folder-size-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Total size of a repository at a given revision, under the given path|Inline|

<h3 id="get-folder-size-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|path|string|true|none|The normalized path of the subtree, starting with a slash|
|size|integer|true|none|Total size in bytes of all files under the subtree|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Duplicate xet files

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/string/string/lfs-files/duplicate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "target": {
      "type": "model",
      "name": "string"
    },
    "files": [
      {
        "xetHash": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
        "sha256": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
        "filename": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/datasets/{namespace}/{repo}/lfs-files/duplicate`

Duplicate xet-stored files from this repo (source) into another repo (target) by xet hash, without re-uploading file bytes. The caller must then commit the files with their sha256/size as usual.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "target": {
    "type": "model",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "files": [
    {
      "xetHash": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
      "sha256": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
      "filename": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="duplicate-xet-files-2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» target|body|object|true|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » name|body|string|true|none|
|» files|body|[object]|true|none|
|» » xetHash|body|string|true|none|
|» » sha256|body|string|true|none|
|» » filename|body|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » type|model|
|» » type|space|
|» » type|dataset|
|» » type|kernel|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processed": -9007199254740000,
  "succeeded": -9007199254740000,
  "failed": [
    {
      "xetHash": "string",
      "sha256": "string",
      "error": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 207 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processed": -9007199254740000,
  "succeeded": -9007199254740000,
  "failed": [
    {
      "xetHash": "string",
      "sha256": "string",
      "error": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Check upload method

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/string/string/preupload/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "files": [
      {
        "path": "string",
        "size": 0,
        "sample": "string"
      }
    ],
    "gitAttributes": "string",
    "gitIgnore": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/datasets/{namespace}/{repo}/preupload/{rev}`

Check if a file should be uploaded through the Large File mechanism or directly.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "string",
      "size": 0,
      "sample": "string"
    }
  ],
  "gitAttributes": "string",
  "gitIgnore": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="check-upload-method-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|rev|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» files|body|[object]|true|none|
|» » path|body|string|true|none|
|» » size|body|number|true|none|
|» » sample|body|string|true|none|
|» gitAttributes|body|string|false|Provide this parameter if you plan to modify `.gitattributes` yourself at the same time as uploading LFS files. Note that this is not needed if you solely rely on automatic LFS detection from HF: the commit endpoint will automatically edit the `.gitattributes` file to track the files passed to its `lfsFiles` param.|
|» gitIgnore|body|string|false|Content of the .gitignore file for the revision. Optional, otherwise takes the existing content of `.gitignore` for the revision.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "string",
      "uploadMode": "lfs",
      "shouldIgnore": true,
      "oid": "string"
    }
  ],
  "commitOid": "string"
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="check-upload-method-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Files to be uploaded.|Inline|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|The request is invalid|Inline|

<h3 id="check-upload-method-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|files|[object]|true|none|none|
|» path|string|true|none|none|
|» uploadMode|string|true|none|none|
|» shouldIgnore|boolean|true|none|none|
|» oid|string|false|none|The oid of the blob if it already exists in the repository. If the blob is a LFS file, it'll be the lfs oid.|
|commitOid|string|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» uploadMode|lfs|
|» uploadMode|regular|

## Commit

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/string/string/commit/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/datasets/{namespace}/{repo}/commit/{rev}`

For legacy reason, we support both `application/json` and `application/x-ndjson` but we recommend using `application/x-ndjson` to create a commit.

JSON-lines payload:
```json
{
  "key": "header",
  "value": {
    "summary": "string (REQUIRED)",
    "description": "string (OPTIONAL - defaults to empty string)",
    "parentCommit": "string (OPTIONAL - 40-character hex SHA)"
  }
}
{
  "key": "file",
  "value": {
    "path": "string (REQUIRED)",
    "content": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set)",
    "encoding": "utf-8 | base64 (OPTIONAL - defaults to utf-8)",
    "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
  }
}
{
  "key": "deletedEntry",
  "value": {
    "path": "string (REQUIRED)"
  }
}
{
  "key": "lfsFile",
  "value": {
    "path": "string (REQUIRED - max 1000 chars)",
    "oid": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set, 64 hex chars)",
    "algo": "sha256 (OPTIONAL - only sha256 supported)",
    "size": "number (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath is set)",
    "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
  }
}
```

JSON payload:
```json
{
  "summary": "string (REQUIRED)",
  "description": "string (OPTIONAL - defaults to empty string)",
  "parentCommit": "string (OPTIONAL - 40-character hex SHA)"
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "string (REQUIRED)",
      "content": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set)",
      "encoding": "utf-8 | base64 (OPTIONAL - defaults to utf-8)",
      "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
    }
  ],
  "deletedEntries": [
    {
      "path": "string (REQUIRED)"
    }
  ],
  "lfsFiles": [
    {
      "path": "string (REQUIRED - max 1000 chars)",
      "oid": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set, 64 hex chars)",
      "algo": "sha256 (OPTIONAL - only sha256 supported)",
      "size": "number (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath is set)",
      "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
    }
  ]
}
```


<h3 id="commit-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|rev|path|string|true|none|
|create_pr|query|string|false|none|
|hot_reload|query|string|false|none|
|Content-Type|header|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Content-Type|application/json|
|Content-Type|application/x-ndjson|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "pullRequestUrl": "string",
  "commitOid": "string",
  "commitUrl": "string",
  "hookOutput": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="commit-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The response of the commit|Inline|

<h3 id="commit-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|success|boolean|true|none|Whether the commit was successful|
|pullRequestUrl|string|false|none|The URL of the pull request|
|commitOid|string|true|none|The OID of the commit|
|commitUrl|string|true|none|The URL of the commit|
|hookOutput|string|true|none|The output of the git hook|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "message": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/datasets/{namespace}/{repo}/super-squash/{rev}`

Squash all commits in the current ref into a single commit with the given message. Action is irreversible.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "message": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="squash-ref-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|rev|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» message|body|string|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "commitId": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="squash-ref-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Response containing the new commit ID after the squash|Inline|

<h3 id="squash-ref-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|commitId|string|true|none|The new commit ID after the squash|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Generate JWT

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/string/string/jwt \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/datasets/{namespace}/{repo}/jwt`

Generate a JWT token for accessing a repository. Supports optional write access for spaces in dev mode, custom expiration, and encryption.

<h3 id="generate-jwt-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|write|query|string|false|none|
|expiration|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|expires_in|query|integer|false|none|
|encrypted|query|string|false|none|
|inference_api|query|string|false|none|
|include_pro_status|query|string|false|none|
|billing_details|query|string|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "accessToken": "string",
  "exp": -9007199254740000,
  "token": "string",
  "encryptedToken": {
    "encrypted": "string",
    "keyId": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="generate-jwt-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The JWT token and related information|Inline|

<h3 id="generate-jwt-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accessToken|string|true|none|The JWT token with Bearer prefix|
|exp|integer|false|none|Token expiration timestamp in seconds (JWT standard)|
|token|string|true|none|The JWT token|
|encryptedToken|object|false|none|Encrypted JWT token and key ID (only if encrypted=true was requested)|
|» encrypted|string|true|none|The encrypted JWT token|
|» keyId|string|true|none|Key ID used to encrypt the token|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

`POST /api/datasets/{namespace}/{repo}/user-access-request/batch`

Accept, reject, reset or set back to pending up to 100 access requests for a single gated repository in one call. The same `status` (and optional `rejectionReason` or `resetReason`) is applied to every request in the list.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "status": "accepted",
  "rejectionReason": "string",
  "resetReason": "string",
  "requests": [
    {
      "requestId": "stringstringstringstring"
    }
  ]
}
```

|body|body|object|false|none|
|» status|body|string|true|none|
|» rejectionReason|body|string|false|none|
|» resetReason|body|string|false|none|
|» requests|body|[object]|true|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » requestId|body|string|true|Id of the request as returned by the listing endpoint; the only identifier when the requester's profile is not shared|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » userId|body|string|true|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » user|body|string|true|none|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|accepted|
|» status|rejected|
|» status|pending|
|» status|reset|

```bash
  -d '{
```

## Create comment

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/string/string/discussions/string/comment \
```
```bash
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
```
```bash
    "comment": "string"
  }'
```

## Get folder size

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/string/string/treesize/string/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/spaces/{namespace}/{repo}/treesize/{rev}/{path}`

Get the total size of a repository at a given revision, optionally under a specific subpath. Returns the total size in bytes of all files under the specified path (recursively). If a file is stored via Xet/LFS, the LFS file size is used.

<h3 id="get-folder-size-2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|rev|path|string|true|none|
|path|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "path": "string",
  "size": -9007199254740000
}
```

<h3 id="get-folder-size-2-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Total size of a repository at a given revision, under the given path|Inline|

<h3 id="get-folder-size-2-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|path|string|true|none|The normalized path of the subtree, starting with a slash|
|size|integer|true|none|Total size in bytes of all files under the subtree|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Duplicate xet files

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/string/string/lfs-files/duplicate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "target": {
      "type": "model",
      "name": "string"
    },
    "files": [
      {
        "xetHash": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
        "sha256": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
        "filename": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/spaces/{namespace}/{repo}/lfs-files/duplicate`

Duplicate xet-stored files from this repo (source) into another repo (target) by xet hash, without re-uploading file bytes. The caller must then commit the files with their sha256/size as usual.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "target": {
    "type": "model",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "files": [
    {
      "xetHash": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
      "sha256": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
      "filename": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="duplicate-xet-files-3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» target|body|object|true|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » name|body|string|true|none|
|» files|body|[object]|true|none|
|» » xetHash|body|string|true|none|
|» » sha256|body|string|true|none|
|» » filename|body|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » type|model|
|» » type|space|
|» » type|dataset|
|» » type|kernel|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processed": -9007199254740000,
  "succeeded": -9007199254740000,
  "failed": [
    {
      "xetHash": "string",
      "sha256": "string",
      "error": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 207 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processed": -9007199254740000,
  "succeeded": -9007199254740000,
  "failed": [
    {
      "xetHash": "string",
      "sha256": "string",
      "error": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

## Check upload method

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/string/string/preupload/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "files": [
      {
        "path": "string",
        "size": 0,
        "sample": "string"
      }
    ],
    "gitAttributes": "string",
    "gitIgnore": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/spaces/{namespace}/{repo}/preupload/{rev}`

Check if a file should be uploaded through the Large File mechanism or directly.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "string",
      "size": 0,
      "sample": "string"
    }
  ],
  "gitAttributes": "string",
  "gitIgnore": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="check-upload-method-2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|rev|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» files|body|[object]|true|none|
|» » path|body|string|true|none|
|» » size|body|number|true|none|
|» » sample|body|string|true|none|
|» gitAttributes|body|string|false|Provide this parameter if you plan to modify `.gitattributes` yourself at the same time as uploading LFS files. Note that this is not needed if you solely rely on automatic LFS detection from HF: the commit endpoint will automatically edit the `.gitattributes` file to track the files passed to its `lfsFiles` param.|
|» gitIgnore|body|string|false|Content of the .gitignore file for the revision. Optional, otherwise takes the existing content of `.gitignore` for the revision.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "string",
      "uploadMode": "lfs",
      "shouldIgnore": true,
      "oid": "string"
    }
  ],
  "commitOid": "string"
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="check-upload-method-2-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Files to be uploaded.|Inline|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|The request is invalid|Inline|

<h3 id="check-upload-method-2-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|files|[object]|true|none|none|
|» path|string|true|none|none|
|» uploadMode|string|true|none|none|
|» shouldIgnore|boolean|true|none|none|
|» oid|string|false|none|The oid of the blob if it already exists in the repository. If the blob is a LFS file, it'll be the lfs oid.|
|commitOid|string|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» uploadMode|lfs|
|» uploadMode|regular|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

</aside>

## Commit

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/string/string/commit/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/spaces/{namespace}/{repo}/commit/{rev}`

For legacy reason, we support both `application/json` and `application/x-ndjson` but we recommend using `application/x-ndjson` to create a commit.

JSON-lines payload:
```json
{
  "key": "header",
  "value": {
    "summary": "string (REQUIRED)",
    "description": "string (OPTIONAL - defaults to empty string)",
    "parentCommit": "string (OPTIONAL - 40-character hex SHA)"
  }
}
{
  "key": "file",
  "value": {
    "path": "string (REQUIRED)",
    "content": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set)",
    "encoding": "utf-8 | base64 (OPTIONAL - defaults to utf-8)",
    "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
  }
}
{
  "key": "deletedEntry",
  "value": {
    "path": "string (REQUIRED)"
  }
}
{
  "key": "lfsFile",
  "value": {
    "path": "string (REQUIRED - max 1000 chars)",
    "oid": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set, 64 hex chars)",
    "algo": "sha256 (OPTIONAL - only sha256 supported)",
    "size": "number (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath is set)",
    "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
  }
}
```

JSON payload:
```json
{
  "summary": "string (REQUIRED)",
  "description": "string (OPTIONAL - defaults to empty string)",
  "parentCommit": "string (OPTIONAL - 40-character hex SHA)"
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "string (REQUIRED)",
      "content": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set)",
      "encoding": "utf-8 | base64 (OPTIONAL - defaults to utf-8)",
      "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
    }
  ],
  "deletedEntries": [
    {
      "path": "string (REQUIRED)"
    }
  ],
  "lfsFiles": [
    {
      "path": "string (REQUIRED - max 1000 chars)",
      "oid": "string (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath not set, 64 hex chars)",
      "algo": "sha256 (OPTIONAL - only sha256 supported)",
      "size": "number (OPTIONAL - required if oldPath is set)",
      "oldPath": "string (OPTIONAL - for move/rename operations)"
    }
  ]
}
```


<h3 id="commit-2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|rev|path|string|true|none|
|create_pr|query|string|false|none|
|hot_reload|query|string|false|none|
|Content-Type|header|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Content-Type|application/json|
|Content-Type|application/x-ndjson|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "pullRequestUrl": "string",
  "commitOid": "string",
  "commitUrl": "string",
  "hookOutput": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="commit-2-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The response of the commit|Inline|

<h3 id="commit-2-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|success|boolean|true|none|Whether the commit was successful|
|pullRequestUrl|string|false|none|The URL of the pull request|
|commitOid|string|true|none|The OID of the commit|
|commitUrl|string|true|none|The URL of the commit|
|hookOutput|string|true|none|The output of the git hook|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

```json
  "accessToken": "string",

    "keyId": "string"
  }
}
```

## Quick search

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/quicksearch \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "q": "",
    "limit": 1,
    "lang": "aa",
    "library": "aadya-neural",
    "type": [
      "model"
    ],
    "orgsFilter": [
      "own"
    ],
    "reposFilter": [
      "skip_disabled"
    ],
    "pipelines": [
      "text-classification"
    ],
    "exclude": [],
    "namespace": "string",
    "includeInvitees": true,
    "repoName": "string",
    "repoType": "dataset",
    "discussionId": "stringstringstringstring",
    "discussionCollectionName": "string",
    "spacesTags": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

<h1 id="hub-api-endpoints-repos">repos</h1>

The following endpoints manage repository settings like creating and deleting a repository.

## Duplicate a repository

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/string/string/duplicate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "repository": "string",
    "private": true,
    "visibility": "private",
    "resourceGroupId": "stringstringstringstring",
    "hardware": "",
    "sleepTimeSeconds": 1,
    "secrets": [],
    "variables": [],
    "volumes": [
      {
        "type": "bucket",
        "source": "string",
        "mountPath": "string",
        "revision": "string",
        "readOnly": true,
        "path": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/{repoType}/{namespace}/{repo}/duplicate`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "repository": "string",
  "private": true,
  "visibility": "private",
  "resourceGroupId": "stringstringstringstring",
  "hardware": "",
  "sleepTimeSeconds": 1,
  "secrets": [],
  "variables": [],
  "volumes": [
    {
      "type": "bucket",
      "source": "string",
      "mountPath": "string",
      "revision": "string",
      "readOnly": true,
      "path": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="duplicate-a-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|repoType|path|string|true|none|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» repository|body|string|true|none|
|» private|body|boolean|false|none|
|» visibility|body|string|false|none|
|» resourceGroupId|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» hardware|body|string|false|none|
|» sleepTimeSeconds|body|integer \| number|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|number|false|none|
|» secrets|body|[object]|false|none|
|» » key|body|string|true|none|
|» » description|body|string|false|none|
|» » value|body|string|true|none|
|» variables|body|[object]|false|none|
|» » key|body|string|true|none|
|» » description|body|string|false|none|
|» » value|body|string|true|none|
|» volumes|body|[object]|false|HuggingFace Buckets or Repos to mount as volumes in the duplicated Space.|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » source|body|string|true|Source identifier, e.g. 'username/my-bucket' or 'username/my-model'|
|» » mountPath|body|string(starts_with)|true|Mount path inside the container, e.g. '/data'|
|» » revision|body|string|false|Git revision (only for repos, defaults to 'main')|
|» » readOnly|body|boolean|false|Read-only mount (true for repos, false default for buckets)|
|» » path|body|string|false|Subfolder prefix inside the bucket/repo to mount, e.g. 'path/to/dir'|

## Duplication status

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/string/string/duplicate/status \
```

`GET /api/{repoType}/{namespace}/{repo}/duplicate/status`

<h3 id="duplication-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|repoType|path|string|true|none|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|repoType|models|
|repoType|datasets|
|repoType|spaces|

```json

  "pending": true,
  "filesTotal": -9007199254740000,
  "filesCopied": -9007199254740000

```

<h3 id="duplication-status-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Progress of the background LFS/Xet copy of a duplicated repository|Inline|

<h3 id="duplication-status-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pending|boolean|true|none|True while the LFS/Xet files are still being copied|
|filesTotal|integer|false|none|Number of LFS/Xet files the duplicate references|
|filesCopied|integer|false|none|Number of files copied so far|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Create repository

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/repos/create \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "organization": "string",
    "region": "us",
    "license": "apache-2.0",
    "license_name": "string",
    "license_link": "LICENSE",
    "private": true,
    "visibility": "private",
    "resourceGroupId": "stringstringstringstring",
    "files": [
      {
        "content": "string",
        "path": "string",
        "encoding": "utf-8"
      }
    ],
    "type": "dataset"
  }'
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Repository created, url is given|Inline|

<h3 id="create-repository-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string|true|none|none|
|name|string|true|none|none|
|id|string|true|none|A hex string of 24 characters representing an ObjectId.|
|filesCopyPending|boolean|false|none|none|

Status Code **409**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|error|string|true|none|none|
|url|string|true|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Move repo

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/repos/move \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "fromRepo": "black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev",
    "toRepo": "string",
    "type": "model"
  }'
```

`POST /api/repos/move`

Move or rename a repo

> Body parameter

```json
  "fromRepo": "black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev",
  "toRepo": "string",
  "type": "model"
}
```

|body|body|object|false|none|

|» toRepo|body|string|true|none|
|» type|body|string|false|none|

> Code samples

<h1 id="hub-api-endpoints-orgs">orgs</h1>

The following endpoints let you interact with Hub Organizations and their members.

## Member access tokens

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/organizations/string/settings/tokens \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/organizations/{name}/settings/tokens`

List the access tokens of the organization's members. Team or Enterprise only.

<h3 id="member-access-tokens-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|none|
|cursor|query|string|false|none|
|limit|query|integer|false|none|
|q|query|string|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "_id": "stringstringstringstring",
    "displayName": "string",
    "role": "read",
    "last4": "string",
    "createdAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "lastUsedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "owner": {
      "_id": "stringstringstringstring",
      "name": "string",
      "fullname": "string",
      "avatarUrl": "string"
    },
    "authorization": {
      "status": "pending",
      "requestedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "authorizedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "authorizer": {
        "name": "string",
        "fullname": "string",
        "avatarUrl": "string"
      }
    },
    "fineGrained": {
      "scoped": [
        {
          "entity": {
            "_id": "stringstringstringstring",
            "type": "dataset"
          },
          "permissions": [
            "repo.read"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

<h3 id="member-access-tokens-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Array of organization member access tokens|Inline|

<h3 id="member-access-tokens-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[object]|false|none|none|
|» _id|string|true|none|A hex string of 24 characters representing an ObjectId.|
|» displayName|string|true|none|Name the owner gave the token. Provided when the organization requires administrator approval of member tokens|
|» role|string|true|none|Kind of access the token carries. `read` and `write` reach everything their owner can reach, while `fineGrained` is limited to the permissions listed under `fineGrained`|
|» last4|string|false|none|Last 4 characters of the token's value, the only part of it ever returned. Absent on tokens created before this was recorded|
|» createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|Date the token was created, or the date it was last rotated|
|» lastUsedAt|string(date-time)|false|none|Date the token last authenticated a request. Absent on tokens that have never been used|
|» owner|object|true|none|Organization member the token belongs to|
|» » _id|string|true|none|A hex string of 24 characters representing an ObjectId.|
|» » name|string|true|none|Username of the member|
|» » fullname|string|true|none|none|
|» » avatarUrl|string|true|none|none|
|» authorization|object|false|none|Where the token stands in the organization's approval flow. Reported by organizations that require administrator approval of member tokens, and on any token whose access has been revoked|
|» » status|string|true|none|`pending` while the token awaits an administrator's decision, `approved` once it may act on the organization, `denied` if an administrator refused it, and `revoked` if an administrator withdrew access it had already been granted|
|» » requestedAt|string(date-time)|true|none|Date the token first requested access to the organization|
|» » authorizedAt|string(date-time)|false|none|Date the token was granted access, recorded when the organization grants it automatically because the owner already holds write access|
|» » authorizer|object|false|none|User who granted the token its access. Absent when `authorizedAt` is, and when that account has since been deleted|
|» » » name|string|true|none|none|
|» » » fullname|string|true|none|none|
|» » » avatarUrl|string|true|none|none|
|» fineGrained|object|false|none|Permissions carried by a `fineGrained` token, narrowed to those that bear on the organization. Absent on `read` and `write` tokens, whose access is not expressed as a permission list, and never covering the account-wide permissions the token may hold elsewhere|
|» » scoped|[object]|true|none|Permissions the token holds on individual entities, limited to the organization and the repositories it owns. Scopes pointing elsewhere are omitted|
|» » » entity|object|true|none|Entity the permissions apply to the organization itself, or one of its repositories|
|» » » » _id|string|true|none|A hex string of 24 characters representing an ObjectId.|
|» » » » type|string|true|none|none|
|» » » permissions|[string]|true|none|Permissions the token holds on the entity|

## Revoke member token

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/organizations/string/settings/tokens/string/revoke \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/organizations/{name}/settings/tokens/{tokenId}/revoke`

An org admin can revoke a token's access to the org. The token itself isn't deleted, it still works outside the org. The token id is the one displayed in the org token settings page or through the tokens listing API endpoint. Enterprise only.

<h3 id="revoke-member-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|none|
|tokenId|path|string|true|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Rotate SSO credentials

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/organizations/string/settings/sso/credentials \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "clientSecret": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/organizations/{name}/settings/sso/credentials`

Update SSO credentials of the organization's SSO configuration. SSO stays enabled and does not need to be re-tested, so rotation causes no downtime. Requires a paid plan.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "clientSecret": "string"
}
```

|name|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» *anyOf*|body|object|false|OIDC client secret|
|» clientSecret|body|string|true|none|

|» x509Cert|body|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
null
```

```json
          "name": "string",
```

```json
            "privateGB": 0,
            "publicGB": 0
          },
          "inference": {
            "requestCount": 0,
            "costCents": 0
          },
          "compute": {
            "spaces": {
              "uptimeSec": 0,

            },

}
```

Get org inference-provider usage per member, model and provider, returned as a time-series of daily periods. Window is [startDate, endDate], defaults to the current month.         "costCents": 0,
```json
        "inputTokens": 0,
        "outputTokens": 0,

]
```

## Create service-account token

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/organizations/string/service-accounts/string/tokens \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

  -d '{
    "displayName": "API Token",
    "permissions": [],
    "repoIds": [
      "stringstringstringstring"
    ],

    "endpointPatterns": [],
    "skipNetworkSecurity": false
  }'
```

`POST /api/organizations/{name}/service-accounts/{serviceAccountId}/tokens`

Create a new access token for a service account. Store the token securely - it cannot be retrieved later.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "displayName": "API Token",
  "permissions": [],
  "repoIds": [
    "stringstringstringstring"
  ],
  "repoPermissions": [],
  "endpointPatterns": [],
  "skipNetworkSecurity": false
}
```

<h3 id="create-service-account-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|none|
|serviceAccountId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» displayName|body|string|false|Display name for the token|
|» permissions|body|[string]|false|Org-wide permissions for this token|
|» repoIds|body|[string]|false|Repositories to grant `repoPermissions` on. Can be repositories owned by the organization or any public repository. These override the org-wide permissions.|
|» repoPermissions|body|[string]|false|Permissions granted on the selected `repoIds`.|
|» endpointPatterns|body|[string]|false|Inference endpoint name patterns (wildcards allowed, e.g. `gpt2-*`) restricting the token's org-wide Inference Endpoint permissions to matching endpoints. Empty means all endpoints.|
|» skipNetworkSecurity|body|boolean|false|Exempt this token from the org's Network Security enforcement (IP allowlist and content access policy). Enterprise Plus only, and requires the `org.networkSecurity.write` permission.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» permissions|repo.content.read|
|» permissions|repo.contribute.write|
|» permissions|repo.write|
|» permissions|inference.serverless.write|
|» permissions|inference.endpoints.infer.write|
|» permissions|inference.endpoints.write|
|» permissions|org.read|
|» permissions|org.write|
|» permissions|collection.read|
|» permissions|collection.write|
|» permissions|resourceGroup.write|
|» permissions|job.write|
|» permissions|org.serviceAccounts.read|
|» permissions|org.serviceAccounts.write|
|» permissions|org.auditLog.write|
|» repoPermissions|repo.content.read|
|» repoPermissions|repo.write|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "token": "string",
  "tokenInfo": {
    "_id": "string",
    "displayName": "string",
    "createdAt": "string",
    "permissions": [
      "string"
    ],
    "repoIds": [
      "string"
    ],
    "repoPermissions": [
      "string"
    ],
    "endpointPatterns": [
      "string"
    ],
    "skipNetworkSecurity": true
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-service-account-token-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created token|Inline|

<h3 id="create-service-account-token-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|token|string|true|none|The access token - store this securely, it cannot be retrieved later|
|tokenInfo|object|true|none|none|
|» _id|string|true|none|none|
|» displayName|string|true|none|none|
|» createdAt|string|true|none|none|
|» permissions|[string]|false|none|none|
|» repoIds|[string]|true|none|none|
|» repoPermissions|[string]|true|none|none|
|» endpointPatterns|[string]|true|none|none|
|» skipNetworkSecurity|boolean|true|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Start a job

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/jobs/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "spaceId": {},
    "dockerImage": "string",
    "arguments": [
      "string"
    ],
    "command": [
      "string"
    ],
    "environment": {},
    "secrets": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "flavor": "cpu-basic",
    "arch": "amd64",
    "timeoutSeconds": null,
    "attempts": 1,
    "labels": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "volumes": [
      {
        "type": "bucket",
        "source": "string",
        "mountPath": "string",
        "revision": "string",
        "readOnly": true,
        "path": "string"
      }
    ],
    "expose": {
      "ports": [
        1
      ],
      "portsPublic": [
        1
      ]
    },
    "ssh": {
      "enabled": false
    },
    "network": {
      "group": "string",
      "aliases": []
    },
    "resourceGroupId": "stringstringstringstring"
  }'
```

## Create scheduled job

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/scheduled-jobs/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "jobSpec": {
      "spaceId": {},
      "dockerImage": "string",
      "arguments": [
        "string"
      ],
      "command": [
        "string"
      ],
      "environment": {},
      "secrets": {
        "property1": "string",
        "property2": "string"
      },
      "flavor": "cpu-basic",
      "arch": "amd64",
      "timeoutSeconds": null,
      "attempts": 1,
      "labels": {
        "property1": "string",
        "property2": "string"
      },
      "volumes": [
        {
          "type": "bucket",
          "source": "string",
          "mountPath": "string",
          "revision": "string",
          "readOnly": true,
          "path": "string"
        }
      ],
      "expose": {
        "ports": [
          1
        ],
        "portsPublic": [
          1
        ]
      },
      "ssh": {
        "enabled": false
      },
      "network": {
        "group": "string",
        "aliases": []
      },
      "resourceGroupId": "stringstringstringstring"
    },
    "schedule": "string",
    "suspend": false,
    "concurrency": false
  }'
```

## Run job

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/scheduled-jobs/string/string/run \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/scheduled-jobs/{namespace}/{jobId}/run`

Trigger a scheduled job run. Trigger a scheduled job to run immediately. Throws an error if an instance is already running and job spec does not allow concurrent runs.

## Update resource group

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/organizations/string/resource-groups/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "spendLimits": {
      "total": 0,
      "inferenceProviders": 0,
      "spaces": 0,
      "jobs": 0,
      "endpoints": 0
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /api/organizations/{name}/resource-groups/{resourceGroupId}`

Update the name, description and/or monthly spend limits (in cents, `null` to remove) of a resource group.

`spendLimits.total` caps the group's combined spend across every product; the per-product limits cap each product on top of it.

Requires the org to have a Team plan or higher.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "spendLimits": {
    "total": 0,
    "inferenceProviders": 0,
    "spaces": 0,
    "jobs": 0,
    "endpoints": 0
  }
}
```

`POST /api/organizations/{name}/resource-groups/{resourceGroupId}/users`

Add one or more organization members to a resource group.

Use the `inherit` role to give a member the same role they have in the organization, following it when it changes.

Requires the org to have a Team plan or higher.

## Invite external user

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/organizations/string/resource-groups/string/invite \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "username": "string",
    "role": "read"
  }'
```

`POST /api/organizations/{name}/resource-groups/{resourceGroupId}/invite`

Invite a user who is not yet an organization member into a resource group. On accepting, they only get access to that resource group, with the requested read or write role.

Requires external invites to be enabled in the organization's resource group settings, unless the caller is an organization admin.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "username": "string",
  "role": "read"
}
```

<h3 id="invite-external-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|none|
|resourceGroupId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» username|body|string|true|Username of an existing Hugging Face user|
|» role|body|string|true|Role the invitee gets inside the resource group|

## Change user role

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/organizations/string/resource-groups/string/users/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "role": "admin"
  }'
```

`PATCH /api/organizations/{name}/resource-groups/{resourceGroupId}/users/{username}`

Change the role of a user in a resource group. In a SCIM-managed resource group, pass `resetToScimRole` to undo a manual role change and restore the role mapped from the user's SCIM groups.

Use the `inherit` role to give the member the same role they have in the organization, following it when it changes.

Requires the org to have a Team plan or higher.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "role": "admin"
}
```

<h3 id="change-user-role-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|none|
|resourceGroupId|path|string|true|none|
|username|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» role|body|string|true|none|
|» *anyOf*|body|object|false|Reset the role to the one mapped from SCIM groups|
|» resetToScimRole|body|boolean|true|none|

## Update resource group settings

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/organizations/string/resource-groups/settings \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "minRoleToCreate": "admin",
    "allowExternalInvites": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/organizations/{name}/resource-groups/settings`

Update the org-wide resource group settings. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

Enabling `allowExternalInvites` lets resource group admins add members to the org, consuming billable seats.

Requires the org to have a Team plan or higher.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "minRoleToCreate": "admin",
  "allowExternalInvites": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-resource-group-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|name|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|

|» allowExternalInvites|body|string \| boolean|false|Whether resource group admins may invite users from outside the organization|

|» minRoleToCreate|write|
|» minRoleToCreate|contributor|
|» minRoleToCreate|read|

```json
}
```

## Update paper links

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/papers/string/links \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "projectPage": "http://example.com",
    "githubRepo": "http://example.com",
    "organizationId": "stringstringstringstring"
  }'
```

`POST /api/papers/{paperId}/links`

Update the project page, GitHub repository, or submitting organization for a paper. Requires the requester to be the paper author, the Daily Papers submitter, or a papers admin.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "projectPage": "http://example.com",
  "githubRepo": "http://example.com",
  "organizationId": "stringstringstringstring"
}
```

<h3 id="update-paper-links-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|paperId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» projectPage|body|string(uri) \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string(uri)|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» githubRepo|body|string(uri) \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string(uri)|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» organizationId|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|

```bash
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "mediaUrls": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/papers/{paperId}/media`

Replace the media shown on a Daily Papers submission. Requires the requester to be the paper author, the Daily Papers submitter, or a papers admin.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "mediaUrls": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-paper-media-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|paperId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» mediaUrls|body|[string]|true|Media URLs, in display order|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{}
```

<h3 id="update-paper-media-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Paper media updated|Inline|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h1 id="hub-api-endpoints-collections">collections</h1>

Use Collections to group repositories from the Hub (Models, Datasets, Spaces and Papers) on a dedicated page.

You can learn more about it in the Collections [guide](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/collections). Collections can also be managed using the Python client (see [guide](https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/main/en/guides/collections)).

## Get a collection

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/collections/string/string-string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|slug|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|

## Delete a collection

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/collections/string/string-string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/collections/{namespace}/{slug}-{id}`

## Update a collection

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/collections/string/string-string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "position": 0,
    "private": true,
    "theme": "orange",
    "title": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "gating": false
  }'
```

`PATCH /api/collections/{namespace}/{slug}-{id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "position": 0,
  "private": true,
  "theme": "orange",
  "title": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "gating": false
}
```

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

</aside>

## Get a collection

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/collections/string/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/collections/{namespace}/{slug}`

<h3 id="get-a-collection-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|slug|path|string|true|none|

## Delete a collection

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/collections/string/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/collections/{namespace}/{slug}`

<h3 id="delete-a-collection-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|slug|path|string|true|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Update a collection

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/collections/string/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "position": 0,
    "private": true,
    "theme": "orange",
    "title": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "gating": false
  }'
```

`PATCH /api/collections/{namespace}/{slug}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "position": 0,
  "private": true,
  "theme": "orange",
  "title": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "gating": false
}
```

## Add item

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/collections/string/string-string/items \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "item": {
      "type": "paper",
      "id": "string"
    },
    "note": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/collections/{namespace}/{slug}-{id}/items`

Add an item to a collection

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "item": {
    "type": "paper",
    "id": "string"
  },
  "note": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="add-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|slug|path|string|true|none|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» item|body|object|true|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » id|body|string|true|none|
|» note|body|string|false|none|

## Add item

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/collections/string/string/items \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "item": {
      "type": "paper",
      "id": "string"
    },
    "note": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/collections/{namespace}/{slug}/items`

Add an item to a collection

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "item": {
    "type": "paper",
    "id": "string"
  },
  "note": "string"
}
```

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Link|string||Link header for pagination, can contain a `rel="next"` link|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Create a collection

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/collections \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "title": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "namespace": "string",
    "item": {
      "type": "paper",
      "id": "string"
    },
    "private": true,
    "resourceGroupId": "stringstringstringstring"
  }'
```

```json
}
```

|body|body|object|false|none|

<h1 id="hub-api-endpoints-buckets">buckets</h1>

Git-free storage buckets for files, powered by Xet. Buckets provide simple file storage without git versioning.

## Duplicate xet files

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/buckets/string/string/lfs-files/duplicate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "target": {
      "type": "model",
      "name": "string"
    },
    "files": [
      {
        "xetHash": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
        "sha256": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
        "filename": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/buckets/{namespace}/{repo}/lfs-files/duplicate`

Duplicate xet-stored files from this repo (source) into another repo (target) by xet hash, without re-uploading file bytes. The caller must then commit the files with their sha256/size as usual.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "target": {
    "type": "model",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "files": [
    {
      "xetHash": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
      "sha256": "stringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstringstri",
      "filename": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="duplicate-xet-files-4-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» target|body|object|true|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » name|body|string|true|none|
|» files|body|[object]|true|none|
|» » xetHash|body|string|true|none|
|» » sha256|body|string|true|none|
|» » filename|body|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » type|model|
|» » type|space|
|» » type|dataset|
|» » type|kernel|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processed": -9007199254740000,
  "succeeded": -9007199254740000,
  "failed": [
    {
      "xetHash": "string",
      "sha256": "string",
      "error": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 207 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processed": -9007199254740000,
  "succeeded": -9007199254740000,
  "failed": [
    {
      "xetHash": "string",
      "sha256": "string",
      "error": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="duplicate-xet-files-4-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Duplicate xet files response|Inline|
|207|Multi-Status|Duplicate xet files response|Inline|

<h3 id="duplicate-xet-files-4-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|success|boolean|true|none|True if all requested files were duplicated (or already present)|
|processed|integer|true|none|Total number of unique files processed|
|succeeded|integer|true|none|Number of files duplicated or already present in the target|
|failed|[object]|true|none|Per-file failures|
|» xetHash|string|true|none|Xet content hash of the file that failed|
|» sha256|string|true|none|sha256 of the file that failed|
|» error|string|true|none|Error message|

Status Code **207**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|success|boolean|true|none|True if all requested files were duplicated (or already present)|

|» sha256|string|true|none|sha256 of the file that failed|

## Batch file operations

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://huggingface.co/api/buckets/string/string/batch \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/buckets/{namespace}/{repo}/batch`

Accepts NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON) where each line is an addFile, copyFile, or deleteFile instruction.
All add/copy operations must come before all delete operations.

JSON-lines payload:
```json
	'{"type":"addFile","path":"...","xetHash":"...","mtime":...,"mtimeNanos":...,"contentType":"..."}' +
	'{"type":"copyFile","path":"...","xetHash":"...","sourceRepoType":"...","sourceRepoId":"...","mtime":...,"mtimeNanos":...,"contentType":"..."}' +
	'{"type":"deleteFile","path":"..."}'
```

<h3 id="batch-file-operations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|namespace|path|string|true|none|
|repo|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processed": -9007199254740000,
  "succeeded": -9007199254740000,
  "failed": [
    {
      "path": "string",
      "error": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processed": -9007199254740000,
  "succeeded": -9007199254740000,
  "failed": [
    {
      "path": "string",
      "error": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="batch-file-operations-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Batch operation status|Inline|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Batch operation status|Inline|

<h3 id="batch-file-operations-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|success|boolean|true|none|True if all operations succeeded|

|succeeded|integer|true|none|Number of successful operations|
|failed|[object]|true|none|List of failed operations|
|» path|string|true|none|File path that failed|
|» error|string|true|none|Error message|
